trans-unit.source: Select an interaction to view details
trans-unit.target: Dooro isdhexgalka si aad faahfaahinta u aragto

trans-unit.source: Invalid time format. Use hh:mm:ss or mm:ss
trans-unit.target: Qaabka waqtigu waa khaldan yahay. Isticmaal hh:mm:ss ama mm:ss

trans-unit.source: No media has been added here yet.
trans-unit.target: Weli wax warbaahin ah halkan laguma darin.

trans-unit.source: Supported services: YouTube, Vimeo, TikTok, Spotify, direct video/audio links
trans-unit.target: Adeegyada la taageero: YouTube, Vimeo, TikTok, Spotify iyo xiriirro fiidyow/cod oo toos ah

trans-unit.source: YouTube videos only play on a web server
trans-unit.target: Fiidyowyada YouTube waxay ka ciyaaraan oo keliya server-ka webka

trans-unit.source: YouTube only plays embedded videos on pages that are served by a web server. This is a restriction imposed by YouTube, not by WebWriter.
trans-unit.target: YouTube wuxuu fiidyowyada la dhexgeliyey ka ciyaarsiiyaa oo keliya bogagga laga bixiyo server web. Tani waa xaddidaad YouTube saartay, mana aha mid WebWriter ah.

trans-unit.source: As a result, this video will not load in WebWriter's preview mode and in documents opened directly from a device. To let your students watch it, publish the document to a web server (e.g. WebWriter Cloud) and share the link from there.
trans-unit.target: Sidaas darteed fiidyowgani kama soo muuqan doono habka hordhaca WebWriter ama dukumeentiyada si toos ah qalab looga furay. Si ardaydu u daawadaan, ku daabac dukumeentiga server web (tusaale WebWriter Cloud) oo la wadaag xiriirka halkaas.

trans-unit.source: If you want to distribute this document as a file rather than through a web server, use a different video source instead of YouTube.
trans-unit.target: Haddii aad rabto inaad dukumeentiga fayl ahaan u qaybiso halkii aad server web ka adeegsan lahayd, isticmaal il fiidyow kale oo aan YouTube ahayn.

trans-unit.source: Videos from other sources and uploaded video or audio files aren't affected by this.
trans-unit.target: Tani ma saamayso fiidyowyada ilo kale ama faylasha fiidyowga iyo codka ee la soo geliyey.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee isticmaal YouTube

trans-unit.source: This file could not be read. Please try again or choose a different file.
trans-unit.target: Faylka lama akhrin karin. Mar kale isku day ama dooro fayl kale.

trans-unit.source: This file type isn't supported. Please choose an MP4 or WebM video, or an MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC or OGG audio file.
trans-unit.target: Nooca faylkan lama taageero. Dooro fiidyow MP4 ama WebM, ama fayl cod MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC ama OGG ah.

trans-unit.source: The media player could not be started. Please try again.
trans-unit.target: Ciyaaryahanka warbaahinta lama bilaabi karin. Mar kale isku day.

trans-unit.source: This file could not be loaded. It is damaged or isn't a video or audio file.
trans-unit.target: Faylka lama rari karin. Wuu dhaawacmay ama ma aha fayl fiidyow/cod.

trans-unit.source: Spotify albums and playlists aren't supported. Please use a link to a single track or episode.
trans-unit.target: Albamyada iyo liisaska Spotify lama taageero. Isticmaal xiriir hal hees ama hal qayb ah.

trans-unit.source: The media could not be loaded. The link may be broken or the file may no longer exist.
trans-unit.target: Warbaahinta lama rari karin. Xiriirku wuu jaban yahay ama faylku ma jiro mar dambe.

trans-unit.source: This link doesn't point to a video or audio file. Please check the link, or use a link to a supported service.
trans-unit.target: Xiriirkani uma jeedo fayl fiidyow ama cod. Hubi xiriirka ama isticmaal mid adeeg la taageero.

trans-unit.source: Loading the media was aborted. Please try again.
trans-unit.target: Rarista warbaahinta waa la joojiyey. Mar kale isku day.

trans-unit.source: The media could not be loaded because of a network error. Please check your internet connection, then try again.
trans-unit.target: Warbaahinta lama rari karin cilad shabakad awgeed. Hubi internetka oo mar kale isku day.

trans-unit.source: The media file is damaged or uses a format your browser cannot play.
trans-unit.target: Faylka warbaahintu wuu dhaawacmay ama wuxuu leeyahay qaab uusan biraawsarku ciyaari karin.

trans-unit.source: The media could not be loaded. The link may be broken, or the format isn't supported by your browser.
trans-unit.target: Warbaahinta lama rari karin. Xiriirku wuu jaban yahay ama biraawsarku ma taageero qaabka.

trans-unit.source: The media could not be loaded. Please check the link and your internet connection, then try again.
trans-unit.target: Warbaahinta lama rari karin. Hubi xiriirka iyo internetka oo mar kale isku day.

trans-unit.source: This YouTube link is invalid. Please check the link and try again.
trans-unit.target: Xiriirkan YouTube ma saxna. Hubi oo mar kale isku day.

trans-unit.source: This YouTube video doesn't exist or is private.
trans-unit.target: Fiidyowgan YouTube ma jiro ama waa gaar.

trans-unit.source: The owner of this YouTube video doesn't allow it to be embedded. Please use a different video.
trans-unit.target: Milkiilaha fiidyowgan YouTube ma oggola in la dhexgeliyo. Isticmaal fiidyow kale.

trans-unit.source: YouTube refuses to play this video here because the page doesn't identify itself to YouTube. This happens in WebWriter's preview mode or in documents opened directly from your device. Publish this document to a web server (e.g. WebWriter Cloud) and open it from there.
trans-unit.target: YouTube wuxuu diidayaa inuu fiidyowgan halkan ka ciyaarsiiyo sababtoo ah boggu isma aqoonsiinayo YouTube. Tani waxay dhacdaa habka hordhaca WebWriter ama dukumeentiyada si toos ah qalab looga furay. Ku daabac dukumeentiga server web (tusaale WebWriter Cloud) oo halkaas ka fur.

trans-unit.source: The YouTube video could not be loaded. Please check the link and your internet connection, then try again.
trans-unit.target: Fiidyowga YouTube lama rari karin. Hubi xiriirka iyo internetka, dabadeed mar kale isku day.

trans-unit.source: The Vimeo video could not be loaded. It may not exist, may be private, or may not allow being embedded.
trans-unit.target: Fiidyowga Vimeo lama rari karin. Waxaa laga yaabaa inuusan jirin, inuu gaar yahay, ama aan la dhexgelin karin.

trans-unit.source: The TikTok video could not be loaded. It may not exist, may be private, or may not allow being embedded.
trans-unit.target: Fiidyowga TikTok lama rari karin. Waxaa laga yaabaa inuusan jirin, inuu gaar yahay, ama aan la dhexgelin karin.

trans-unit.source: The Spotify track could not be loaded. It may not exist or may not be available in your region.
trans-unit.target: Heesta Spotify lama rari karin. Waxaa laga yaabaa inaysan jirin ama aan laga heli karin gobolkaaga.

trans-unit.source: The media took too long to load. Please check the link and your internet connection, then try again.
trans-unit.target: Rarista warbaahintu waqti badan ayay qaadatay. Hubi xiriirka iyo internetka oo mar kale isku day.

trans-unit.source: Are you sure you want to remove the current audio?
trans-unit.target: Ma hubtaa inaad ka saarayso codka hadda jira?

trans-unit.source: Are you sure you want to remove the current video?
trans-unit.target: Ma hubtaa inaad ka saarayso fiidyowga hadda jira?

trans-unit.source: Also remove all interactions and chapters
trans-unit.target: Sidoo kale ka saar dhammaan isdhexgalka iyo cutubyada

trans-unit.source: Remove the current media and keep its interactions and chapters?
trans-unit.target: Ma rabtaa inaad ka saarto warbaahinta hadda jirta adigoo ilaalinaya isdhexgalkeeda iyo cutubyadeeda?
